vault_lines: Fuck-fuck-fuck a beat, I was tryna beat a case (Gang, gang)
meaning:
The song is called “The Race” because Tay-K recorded it while being on the run from law enforcement.

In July 2016, Tay-K was involved in a home invasion in Mansfield, Texas, that resulted in the death of 21-year-old, Ethan Walker. He was placed on house arrest, but cut off his ankle monitor a year later and fled to New Jersey where he was caught by US Marshals after a week long search.

Tay-K was extradited back to Texas to be tried on charges of capital murder. It’s thought that he fled Texas because prosecutors were looking to try the then 16-year-old as an adult, making him eligible for the death penalty. Tay-K was sentenced to 55 years in prison in July 2019.
